title: Loot Drop (Payload)
description: The full result of one crate open. Stored as JSON payload inside lootbox_drop.payload. Contains the character, power roll, shiny flag, value, and the fairness inputs needed to verify the roll.

crateId.description: Which crate was opened (e.g. starter-crate, harvest-crate).

power.description: Power roll. Higher is better (unlike CS:GO float).

shiny.description: Holo variant. Cosmetic, but doubles the drop's value.

value.description: Computed drop value in arbitrary units. power * rarityMultiplier * (shiny ? 2 : 1).

rarity.description: Raw roll for rarity tier selection.

character.description: Raw roll for character selection within tier.

serverSeedHash.description: SHA256 of the server seed in effect.

nonce.description: Nonce value used for this specific roll.

openedAt.description: ISO 8601. When the crate was opened.
